memories.text: I've lived in Montreal since grad school, in a walk-up in the Plateau, and the winters are no joke.
I run user interviews at Lumière Media, and half my job is begging people to show up.
My title is UX researcher, so I watch people struggle with apps for a living.
Spinning classes are my therapy, and I go four mornings a week before work.
Use plain language with me, no jargon, even when the topic is technical.
The dentist asked again, and no, I'm not allergic to latex, gloves are fine.
My twin brother Karim lives in Calgary and keeps telling me to visit the Rockies.
Our research readout happens every Thursday at 10.
My usability study recipe: write a screener, recruit eight participants, run 45-minute sessions, and synthesize on sticky notes the same day.
I've been pulled onto Northstar, a project redesigning a transit fare app.
Northstar is in discovery, we're interviewing commuters at bus stops.
I joined the Mile End Book Club, which is mostly wine and gossip but we do read.
Went to the winter carnival in Quebec City and slid down the ice slide three times.
I'm allergic to tree nuts, so I always ask about pesto and baklava.
For za'atar manakish I mix za'atar with olive oil, press dimples into the dough, and bake at 230 degrees for eight minutes.
Correction: the research readout moved to Mondays, Thursdays clashed with the exec meeting.
My cousin's engagement party is booked at a banquet hall in Laval.
Northstar is owned by the Lakeshore Transit Authority, they have final say on every screen.
Northstar stalled while we wait for legal to approve the payment flow.
Spent a whole weekend at Osheaga and lost my voice singing along.
The engagement party moved to my aunt's backyard in Mississauga to save money.
We adopted a bunny who chews every cable in the apartment.
I don't have a driver's licence yet, the metro and Bixi bikes cover everything.
Remind me to renew my passport before the 1st of August.
We moved to Toronto in May, and the view of the lake from our building is wild.
I joined Maple Transit Analytics in May as their lead researcher.
Maple Transit Analytics is headquartered in Ottawa, though most of the team is remote.
I report to Grace Chen, she built the research practice there from nothing.
Grace lives in Waterloo and comes into the city on Wednesdays.
I applied to a part-time MBA program, the interviews are in the fall.
My knees gave up on spinning, so yoga is my main workout now.
Northstar is in public beta now and the app store reviews are surprisingly kind.
Flew to Beirut over the holidays to see family and ate my weight in kibbeh.
The MBA program rejected me, so I'm reapplying next year with better essays.
My Sunday reset: clean out the fridge, plan five lunches, and charge every device before bed.
I've never been to Australia, the flight length scares me.
True crime podcasts are my guilty pleasure on long walks.
Remind me to file my taxes before the end of April next year.
